# rank_bm25

`rank_bm25.py` is an unmodified copy of [dorianbrown/rank_bm25](https://github.com/dorianbrown/rank_bm25), commit `47aa3ddf8dc1ebeb7ef4e65f2b4536af44594099`, downloaded on 2026-10-13.

It is licensed under Apache-2.0; the original license is reproduced in `LICENSE.rank_bm25`. The surrounding course tokenization, graph retrieval, document ingestion and tests are this project's implementation. Only the BM25Okapi scorer is used. Upstream preprocessing is deliberately supplied by the caller, as required by its documented API.
